verified_facts: INSPIRE is split into separate local-authority files
a polygon on a local-authority boundary appears in both local-authority files
duplicate presence is therefore expected for boundary-crossing polygons
local-authority file membership is not a unique parcel key
dedupe requires actual feature identity or source provenance
geometry proximity alone is insufficient for safe dedupe
cross-LA duplicates must be resolved before counting candidate polygons
the open INSPIRE subset contains freehold registered property locations
quality_effect: Prevents double-counting a real candidate when the same INSPIRE polygon is present in adjacent local-authority files.
